1.note: Requested certification is explicitly selected repository-profile work through Dagger and commits nothing. The profile and loader are still authority for that requested Gates 1–4 work; a selection named `closeout` is not an automatic closeout invocation. Ordinary closeout runs no gate but the invariant gate, retains exact candidate/approval/lineage checks and code-then-memory Git publication, and does not run certification, code-quality checks, test suites or independent review. A missing profile or certification result does not block that transaction. This does not remove canonical Curator/Reviewer duties or confer independent semantic acceptance on diagnostics. The stable contract locator chooses strict live manifest/journal/history or terminal external archive/receipt plus surviving contract truth. Projection/queue absence is not loss of accepted operation authority. Archive-ready is not cleanup-completed. Tree-comparison result blocks and raw-Git boundary statements report observations and do not replace transaction source-lineage admission.
